enrichment.headline: Adds $227,030 to Ninyo & Moore's contract for added environmental cleanup work at Fremont High
enrichment.summary: The district is expanding an existing environmental services contract with Ninyo & Moore for the Fremont High School new construction project. The added work revises a cleanup plan and prepares completion and monitoring reports requested by the California Department of Toxic Substances Control. The change adds $206,391.00 for basic services plus $20,639.10 for additional services, $227,030.10 in all, raising the contract limit from $175,645.80 to $402,675.90.

enrichment.headline: Adds $52,387.50 and one year for Murakami/Nelson's scoreboard design at Castlemont High field project
enrichment.summary: The district is amending its contract with Murakami/Nelson Architectural Corporation for added design work to replace the scoreboard at the Castlemont High School field and bleachers project, including drawings and responding to state architect review comments. The amendment adds $52,387.50, which includes a $4,762.50 contingency, raising the contract limit from $1,044,900.00 to $1,097,287.50. It also extends the contract by 365 days, to December 31, 2023.
